title: Invert a smoothed affine residual and charge its random action
statement: At X=kappa G+aZ,a=sqrt(1-kappa^2),0<kappa<1, every symmetric Frobenius-L2 residual R has a controlled full inverse of -P_a^G R in the strict noise-divergence gauge. A finite one-residual-action program has conditional mean u and exact energy pi^2||R||_2^2/(8a^2). Scalar source-only P_rho gives bounded inversion iff rho<=a; larger rho and unsmoothed inversion are unbounded.

requires: Exact affine reference and declared source smoothing
An acquired R(y)v action or unbiased substitute with actual energy charged
provides: A skew/Hodge correction is required for the full matrix equation; J0 alone is insufficient
After independent tau-Gaussian reserve, randomization costs<=phi(1)E||Uhat-u||^2/tau^2 in full TV
For valid Stein data, residual P_a R0,r=||R0||_2 and three stated coefficient deviations<=eta, TV<=H(tau)(A eta r+B r^2)+phi(1)c^2 r^2/tau^2, with explicit Section8 constants
Genuine conservative high-frequency residuals have exponential inverse growth while their original proposal laws approach a Gaussian
assumptions: Quadratic behavior requires eta=O(r); fixed reference does not ensure shrinking eta
Only L1 product control; target covariance includes(1+tau^2)I
costs: One residual action is not one g query; full matrix multiply O(d^2), acquired action plus vector work O(d)
Noisy action energy, often O(d), replaces residual energy
Restricted sine validation uses9 original queries and exponential constants; same supplied family permits exact target from one g(0)
contract.units: Gaussian covariance, Frobenius-L2 energy and full TV
contract.obstruction: No acquired reusable quadratic compiler, every-execution polylog query theorem, universal bit bound, priority or practical advantage.
